name: hbm_su_pg_stream_b_safe2_1019

reset_landing.why: ONE face flop per reset port; the SAFE2 source owns the remaining stages (rst_n: 2 serial; bridge_rst_n: balanced kept tree, serial stage A -> terminals and stream feeder F -> P -> terminals) so both clock roots leave reset on the same coincident edge 12q after the face flop

pin_regs.reason: Every boundary bit has its register in RTL: vmr_cmd/su_wq go straight into the request bank region flops, su_rr / ij_* / pg_fault are return-region / inject-region / synchroniser flops, the LG tap registers its local/far/near inputs and outputs, inj_rd/inj_addr are captured per inject region on pg_clk (SAFE2 r5). A wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar (windows 2q..7q) and the release VM 18/15 calendar.

fill_reason.pin_bound: 3,580 external pins (W 1,183 slice S band, E 1,117 LG near, N 758 far requests + COLL inject, S 522) on ~4,200 um2 (SAFE2 r7 map: 4,185) synthesized: <= 6/um needs >= 197 um on W/E, so a 40-60 % outline (~80 x 80) cannot carry them; 216 x 259.2 = the proven pg_stream outline (GPL converged with routability ON at 0ff805777). Pin-bound, waived.

structural_change: LH-PGVM2 10-19 SAFE kit of the PGSTREAM-B tile on the SAFE2 source top (results/rtl/hbm_pgstream_safe_1019/safe2): the 14 roots >32 of 47d9b210c (bridge_rst_n 1,726, tap selects 564, tap/leaf reset 92/73, inject decode 83) replaced by kept source trees / per-region copies, inject pins captured per region (+1 stream edge, H-D4G), and the reset landing moved into the source so both roots release on the same coincident edge (the b_1019 kit 3-stage clk_ctl landing released the stream side one edge early: kitland lockstep FAIL, gate95463 not submittable).

job.purpose: HBM die d4g LIGHT SU slice stream sibling: PGSTREAM-B two-root tile, SAFE2 source (roots <=32, source-owned epoch-exact reset tree, inject pin capture)

seam_windows.name: bridge_request
seam_windows.why: request bank n mod 2 written at serial n (tick 4n), read at stream 4n+6/5/4, rewritten 4n+8 (multirate_bridge_split.sv; bench measured 4q / 2q)

seam_windows.name: bridge_return
seam_windows.why: return bank written at the stream capture edge, staged one serial edge early (X = 8 at RR 10/7 and 18/15): setup 2q, rewrite-after-read 4q (bench measured)

seam_windows.name: inject
seam_windows.why: inject banks written at stream 12m / 12m+3 / 12m+9, read at serial 12m+4 / +8 / +12, rewritten one epoch later (bench measured 3q / 7q); SAFE2: banks q0/q1/q2 in the 5 kept inject regions u_s.g_ij[r].u_r (same sp calendar), inputs captured one stream edge earlier (r5)

cdc_synchronizers.name: pg_fault_level
cdc_synchronizers.why: stream fault OR published by one source register, then exact two-stage serial level synchronizer; one added stream publication edge, no data-calendar effect

cdc_synchronizers.name: pg_leaf_reset
cdc_synchronizers.why: serial leaf reset source -> stage 1 u_s.rq_s0 -> stage 2 = 5 kept identical copies u_s.g_lr[*] (one logical flop; per-load-group copies for fanout <= 32); same two pg_clk ages as b_1019

cdc_synchronizers.name: pg_tap_reset
cdc_synchronizers.why: serial tap reset source -> stage 1 u_s.rs_s0 -> stage 2 = 8 kept identical copies u_s.g_tr[*]

cdc_synchronizers.name: bridge_stream_reset
cdc_synchronizers.why: bridge_rst_n stream feeder: F (clk_ctl, C+4q; 3 kept copies, one logical flop) -> P (pg_clk C+6q, 2q after the release launch) -> 86 kept stream terminals (C+9q) -> stream loads count from C+12q, the same coincident edge as the serial loads
